desc:
Maybe because of *Memories of Phantasm,* I'd imagine the Rumia fight happening over a forest. But then considering the dialogue, I suppose it makes more sense that it's literally the backyard of the shrine?

Anyway, Reimu does [say this](https://en.touhouwiki.net/wiki/Embodiment_of_Scarlet_Devil/Story/Reimu's_Scenario#:%7E:text=%E5%A4%9C%E3%81%AE%E5%A2%83%E5%86%85%E8%A3%8F%E3%81%AF%E3%83%AD%E3%83%9E%E3%83%B3%E3%83%86%E3%82%A3%E3%83%83%E3%82%AF%E3%81%AD) just before fighting Rumia in EoSD.
